text:
Eileen Park: quick sync — weekly KPI snapshot looks odd after the launch drip. sessions up but MQLs down. can we triage before monday's deck? https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-kpis :mag:
kpi-bot: ALERT: conversion rate for 'launch-drip-2026' dropped 46% vs baseline. Suggested checks: UTMs, form listeners, attribution model. https://redwood.app/alerts/4187
Tom Walsh: I saw that. first thing: which conversion metric are we using for the KPI slide? MQL or demo_request?
Eileen Park: using MQL for the public deck. internal shows webinar_regs and demo_requests separately. MQL filters for lead_score >= 30.
Sofia Ruiz: Quick SQL to compare raw signups vs MQLs:
```
SELECT date, sum(signups) as s, sum(CASE WHEN lead_score >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as m
FROM marketing.metrics_daily
WHERE campaign = 'launch-drip-2026'
AND date >= '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
Shows big gap starting 2026-05-07.
Grant Miller: frontend pushed a copy tweak + new analytics tag on 5/7. pinned PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/540. Did we change form id?
Sofia Ruiz: pulling GTM events now. GA4 shows signups up, but our ingestion shows fewer MQLs. likely enrichment/score step dropped some fields needed for scoring (company_size missing).
Tom Walsh: could also be attribution model toggling in the dashboard. I remember someone switched the snapshot to last_touch for a quick look. data_driven yields different channel shares.
Eileen Park: plan proposal: 1) Sofia backfill ingest for 5/05-5/09 to capture missed events; 2) Grant confirm frontend changes and add fallback attributes for scoring; 3) Tom regenerate KPI snapshot with both last_touch and data_driven and append slides. hold messaging until numbers reconcile.
kpi-bot: BACKFILL job 1832 queued by Sofia Ruiz (targets 2026-05-05 -> 2026-05-09). Status: queued.
Sofia Ruiz: starting backfill now. I'll also diff GA4 raw events vs our event logs and post a CSV: https://redwood.app/files/ga4-vs-ingest-1832.csv
Grant Miller: adding `data-company-size` to the signup form in a small hotfix. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/542. will push in 20m and monitor.
Tom Walsh: toggled dashboard to data_driven and exported snapshot. I'll attach both versions to the deck. note: share changes a lot for paid vs email.
Eileen Park: owners confirmed. Sofia - please ping when backfill completes. Tom - update deck slides. Grant - confirm hotfix deployed and monitor for lost attributes. we will revisit before monday 10:00 sync. :calendar:
Sofia Ruiz: backfill job 1832 started (ETA ~1.5h). will post results here.
Grant Miller: hotfix deployed to prod. monitoring logs for attribute presence now.
Sofia Ruiz: backfill complete. recovered 76 MQLs in window. adjusted weekly delta from -46% to -18%. uploading CSV: https://redwood.app/files/backfill-1832-results.csv
Eileen Park: that's better but still under target. Tom please add a note on the deck: "Attribution + enrichment noise affected MQLs; numbers updated after ingest backfill." We'll decide messaging Monday. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
